fields.customfield_10044:
AC-1: POST /orders/{id}/cancel accepts an optional reason from CUSTOMER_REQUEST, DUPLICATE, FRAUD_SUSPECTED, OTHER; the reason is returned by GET /orders/{id}.
AC-2: An unknown reason is rejected with 422 INVALID_REASON and the order is not cancelled.
AC-3: Reason OTHER requires a reason_note of 1-280 characters, otherwise 422.
fields.description: Support needs to know why orders are cancelled. Cancellations should be auditable. Contract: specs/openapi.yaml (CancelRequest, AuditEntry).
